description: This file defines an internal class 'AsyncLock' in the Orleans namespace, implementing an asynchronous mutual exclusion mechanism using SemaphoreSlim. It provides an async-compatible lock with support for 'using' scope, mimicking mutex semantics for async programming.

classes.name: AsyncLock
classes.description: An async mutual exclusion mechanism supporting scoping via 'using', mimicking mutex semantics for async programming.

classes.name: AsyncLock.LockReleaser
classes.description: A disposable helper class used to release the lock when disposed, implementing IDisposable.

methods.name: AsyncLock()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the semaphore with a count of 1.

methods.name: LockAsync()
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires the lock, returning a ValueTask<IDisposable> that releases the lock upon disposal.

methods.name: LockReleaser.Dispose()
methods.description: Releases the semaphore lock, handling potential exceptions silently.
